title: Repair the Core, Not the Symptom: Planning-Graph Repair for Long-Horizon Agents
abstract: arXiv:2607.01767v3 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Long-horizon language agents make interdependent decisions across multiple rounds, forming growing planning graphs in which later decisions depend on earlier states, observations, and tool outputs. Errors in these graphs can therefore propagate through subsequent decisions and amplify over long rollouts. Correcting the most visible failure may therefore fix a symptom while leaving the core that drives downstream errors unchanged. Replaying the entire planning graph provides the opposite extreme, but becomes increasingly expensive as the graph grows and forces an LLM to reason over substantial irrelevant context. We study planning-graph repair: given a failed rollout, the goal is to identify and correct the compact core responsible for continued error propagation while preserving the remainder of the graph. translated_title: 修复核心而非症状：面向长程智能体的规划图修复
translated_abstract: 长程语言智能体在多轮交互中做出相互依赖的决策，形成不断增长的规划图，其中后续决策依赖于先前的状态、观察结果和工具输出。因此，规划图中的错误会通过后续决策传播，并在长轨迹执行中不断放大。修正最明显的失败可能只是治标，而驱动下游错误的核心问题依然未变；重新执行整个规划图则是另一个极端，随着规划图的增长成本越来越高，并迫使大语言模型在大量无关上下文中进行推理。我们研究规划图修复问题：给定一次失败的执行轨迹，目标是识别并修正导致错误持续传播的紧凑核心，同时保留规划图的其余部分。我们首先评估了一系列实用的工程修复策略，包括单错误修复与TopK修复、时间窗口等（摘要在此处截断）。
tldr: 该论文提出“规划图修复”任务，通过识别并只修正失败执行轨迹中导致错误持续传播的紧凑核心子图，而非治标式地修补表面症状或代价高昂地重放整个规划图，从而高效修复长程语言智能体多轮决策中的错误。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces planning-graph repair, which efficiently fixes failed rollouts of long-horizon language agents by identifying and correcting only the compact core responsible for continued error propagation, instead of treating visible symptoms or expensively replaying the entire planning graph.
